full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white long-exposure composite depicts a broad urban square flanked by monumental stone buildings, their façades repeated as translucent traces from many moments. The right-hand building dominates the frame: a long pale wall with rows of windows and dark archways at street level runs diagonally from the lower right toward the far center. Its roof and cornices appear doubled and slightly offset, as though the structure has shifted through time. On the left, another ornate block rises close to the viewer, its columns and windows partially overlaid with ghostly versions of themselves. A paler multi-story structure closes the far end of the square beneath a nearly white sky. Across the center and lower half, pedestrians and vehicles become thin dark wisps and blurred gray accumulations; no one individual remains clear. A narrow dark stair or ramp descends from the right edge into the open street, giving a stable spatial cue among the overlays. The photograph's many exposures produce vertical smears, doubled edges, pale veils, and layered grain. Dense blacks gather in the repeated ground-floor openings and under the right façade, while upper masonry gradually washes into light. Daylight is diffuse and high-key, with no single sharp cast shadow; changing light across time makes highlights hover over one another. The composition holds a recognizable receding plaza within a restless accumulation of moments, suggesting a city remembered and continuously changing.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白长时间复合曝光呈现宽阔城市广场，两侧巨大的石建筑立面化为多个时刻的半透明重复痕迹。右侧建筑支配画面：长长的浅墙有成排窗洞，街道层有深色拱口，从右下斜向远方中央。屋顶与檐口双影略错位，仿佛结构在时间中移动。左边，另一座华丽建筑贴近观者升起，柱子与窗被自身幽灵般的版本局部覆盖。更浅的多层楼体在近白天空下收住广场远端。中央与下半部，行人和车辆化成细暗丝与模糊灰色积影，没有任何人保持清楚。窄深色台阶或坡道从右缘降向空旷街面，在重叠中提供稳定空间线索。多次曝光带来竖向拖影、双重边线、浅色薄幕和层叠颗粒。重复的底层开口及右立面下方聚着浓黑，上方石墙逐渐洗入亮部。日光漫射而高调，没有单一锐利投影；不同时刻的光使亮处互相悬浮。构图在躁动的时刻积累中保留可辨的后退广场，像一座被记忆覆盖且不断变化的城市。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white long-exposure photography stacks many time states into one high-key frame. Repeat edges as offset translucent traces, let moving forms become wisps or dark accumulations, and keep just enough stable geometry to orient the eye. Use pale veils, vertical smearing, grain, and overlapping mid-gray detail rather than one crisp decisive instant. Diffuse daylight lifts upper planes toward white while repeated lower openings or dense zones gather black. Strong perspective can hold the layers together, yet the method transfers to any setting with fixed and moving elements. The effect is ghostly, temporal, and quietly monumental.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白长时间曝光摄影把多个时刻叠进一幅高调画面。让边缘成为错位的半透明重影，让移动形体化为细丝或暗色积影，同时保留足够稳定的几何供视线定位。以浅薄幕、竖向拖痕、颗粒和重叠中灰细节取代一个清晰决定性瞬间。漫射日光把上部平面托向白色，重复的下方开口或密集区域则聚黑。强透视可以整合多层，但机制可迁移到任何有固定与移动元素的场景。效果幽灵般、显出时间，并含蓄宏大。
theme_en: A city square layered through repeated exposures over time
theme_zh: 城市广场在多次时间曝光中层层重叠
name: Michael Wesely
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
